name: Jin Hitomi
source: A member of Egubado. Master of the dark type guardian Kokuryuu. Has a long history with her superior Megumi. Has a negative outlook on life. [spoiler]But after a meeting with Miyuki she begins to have hope for the future and eventually betrays Egubado. Joins after Miyuki's and Yuuko's group meet each other.[/spoiler]
